input.content:
# Requirements for the BMW 1 Series (F70), market EU.
# Derived from the findings of the F70 EU scope by the requirement agent (offline by the
# assistant, D-055). Study scores: CN/EU 2025 study, 1-10 means; "peer" = mean of the other
# BMW models in the same market. Complaint shares: share of all complaint rows of the market.
# Targets marked "assumption" are proposals for the PM, not measured values.
vehicle: F70
market: EU
author: assistant:claude-opus-5-5
requirements:
  - id: REQ-F70-EU-ID-01
    domain: infotainment_digital
    title: Physical controls for climate and a rotary controller option
    statement: >-
      Temperature, fan and seat or steering wheel heating shall have physical controls, and a
      rotary controller (or an equivalent haptic control) shall operate map zoom, lists and
      shortcuts so the driver does not have to aim at the touch screen while driving.
    recommend: true
    recommend_rationale: >-
      Touch screen operation is the largest complaint theme of the F70 in Europe (141 rows, 7.4 %
      of all complaints, 91 usability); 25 owners explicitly ask for the iDrive controller back
      and the operating concept adds 30 rows. Many describe touch-only climate control as unsafe.
    horizon: H1
    horizon_rationale: Physical climate keys and a controller are a life-cycle-impulse change of the centre console.
    markets: [EU]
    findings:
      - {id: FND-F70-EU-VOC-touch_screen_operation, role: primary}
      - {id: FND-F70-EU-VOC-controller_operation, role: primary}
      - {id: FND-F70-EU-VOC-operating_concept_operating_system, role: supporting}
      - {id: FND-F70-EU-VOC-instrument_cluster, role: supporting}
    criteria:
      - {market: EU, metric: Share of touch-screen complaint rows, target: "<= 3 % of complaint rows (today 7.4 %)", method: "Customer feedback, rolling 6 months", basis: assumption}
      - {market: EU, metric: Climate temperature and fan operable without the touch screen, target: "Yes", method: Function test, basis: evidence}
      - {market: EU, metric: Glance time for a temperature change while driving, target: "<= 1.5 s", method: HMI eye-tracking test, basis: assumption}

  - id: REQ-F70-EU-ID-02
    domain: infotainment_digital
    title: Stable infotainment and settings that survive updates
    statement: >-
      The central display and connected functions shall not freeze, go blank or reboot in normal
      use, and over-the-air updates shall keep all personal settings.
    recommend: true
    recommend_rationale: >-
      Connected drive and infotainment technology draws 107 complaint rows with 51 defects
      (blank screens, freezes, lost functions); software updates add 13 rows with 9 defects that
      wiped settings, and the study scores connected services at 7.36 vs peer 7.62.
    horizon: H1
    horizon_rationale: Software quality and update process.
    markets: [EU]
    findings:
      - {id: FND-F70-EU-VOC-connecteddrive_and_infotainment_overall_technolo, role: primary}
      - {id: FND-F70-EU-VOC-remote_software_upgrade_rsu, role: supporting}
      - {id: FND-F70-EU-MET-cn_eu_2025-connected_services, role: supporting}
    criteria:
      - {market: EU, metric: Infotainment defect rows, target: "-60 % within 12 months (today 51)", method: Customer feedback, basis: assumption}
      - {market: EU, metric: User settings kept after an OTA update, target: 100 % of profile settings, method: Update regression test, basis: evidence}
      - {market: EU, metric: Study connected services (1-10), target: ">= 7.6 (today 7.36, peer 7.62)", method: Next EU customer study wave, basis: evidence}

  - id: REQ-F70-EU-ID-03
    domain: infotainment_digital
    title: Functions bought with the car stay included for the first owner
    statement: >-
      Functions that are fitted and shown at handover (high-beam assistant, traffic information,
      3D maps, media apps) shall stay active for the first owner without a subscription, and any
      time-limited content shall be stated clearly at the point of sale.
    recommend: true
    recommend_rationale: >-
      47 complaint rows about connected upgrades, all usability: functions such as automatic high
      beam and live traffic switch off after three months; the catalogue lists Digital Premium as
      time-limited (480 EUR option). Owners feel misled and say they will change brand.
    horizon: H1
    horizon_rationale: Offer and licensing decision; no hardware change.
    markets: [EU]
    findings:
      - {id: REDACTED, role: primary}
      - {id: FND-F70-EU-EQ-connecteddrive_and_infotainment_overall_technolo, role: context}
    criteria:
      - {market: EU, metric: Hardware-enabled safety and lighting functions behind a subscription, target: None, method: Offer check, basis: assumption}
      - {market: EU, metric: Complaint rows about expiring functions, target: "<= 10 per 6 months (today 47)", method: Customer feedback, basis: assumption}
    uncertainties:
      - Touches the digital revenue model; needs a commercial decision beyond the product scope.

  - id: REQ-F70-EU-ID-04
    domain: infotainment_digital
    title: Printed quick-start handbook and better in-car help
    statement: >-
      Every car shall be delivered with a printed, model-specific quick-start handbook, and the
      in-car manual shall be searchable and show only the functions fitted to the car.
    recommend: true
    recommend_rationale: >-
      The owner's manual is the third-largest digital complaint (86 rows, 37 wishes for a printed
      handbook); older owners report being unable to use functions without it.
    horizon: H1
    horizon_rationale: Content and print; no vehicle change.
    markets: [EU]
    findings:
      - {id: FND-F70-EU-VOC-owner_s_manual, role: primary}
    criteria:
      - {market: EU, metric: Printed quick-start handbook at delivery, target: Every car, method: Delivery audit, basis: evidence}
      - {market: EU, metric: Manual complaint rows, target: "<= 20 per 6 months (today 86)", method: Customer feedback, basis: assumption}

  - id: REQ-F70-EU-ID-05
    domain: infotainment_digital
    title: Music from USB sticks
    statement: The USB-C ports shall play audio files from a USB stick, without requiring a smartphone.
    recommend: true
    recommend_rationale: >-
      30 complaint rows, 17 wishes: owners copied their CDs to USB sticks and lost playback with
      the new generation; several say USB only charges.
    horizon: H1
    horizon_rationale: Software (media player and USB data path), possibly a hub change in the life-cycle impulse.
    markets: [EU]
    findings:
      - {id: FND-F70-EU-VOC-usb_port, role: primary}
    criteria:
      - {market: EU, metric: Playback of MP3 and AAC from a FAT32 or exFAT USB stick, target: "Yes", method: Function test, basis: evidence}

  - id: REQ-F70-EU-ID-06
    domain: infotainment_digital
    title: Navigation route choice and clear guidance
    statement: >-
      Navigation shall offer fastest, shortest and road-type preferences, avoid single-track lanes
      on main routes and keep map zoom operable without the touch screen.
    recommend: true
    recommend_rationale: >-
      Navigation draws 29 complaint rows (11 defects) about routes through narrow lanes and
      missing route options; the study scores navigation at 8.30 vs peer 8.71.
    horizon: H1
    horizon_rationale: Software.
    markets: [EU]
    findings:
      - {id: FND-F70-EU-VOC-navigation, role: primary}
      - {id: FND-F70-EU-MET-cn_eu_2025-navigation, role: supporting}
    criteria:
      - {market: EU, metric: Study navigation (1-10), target: ">= 8.7 (today 8.30, peer 8.71)", method: Next EU customer study wave, basis: evidence}
      - {market: EU, metric: Route preference options, target: "Fastest, shortest, avoid narrow roads", method: Function test, basis: assumption}

  - id: REQ-F70-EU-IC-01
    domain: interior_comfort
    title: Supportive, durable seats with lumbar adjustment
    statement: >-
      The front seats shall support the back on long drives, offer lumbar adjustment on the
      volume trims and keep their stitching and shape over the warranty period.
    recommend: true
    recommend_rationale: >-
      Seats draw 50 complaint rows with 24 defects (stitching, loss of shape, squeaks) and comfort
      complaints about M Sport seats; active seats are an option on all six variants.
    horizon: H1
    horizon_rationale: Seat trim, foam and lumbar option within the life-cycle impulse.
    markets: [EU]
    findings:
      - {id: FND-F70-EU-VOC-seats, role: primary}
      - {id: FND-F70-EU-EQ-seats, role: context}
    criteria:
      - {market: EU, metric: Seat defect rows, target: "<= 8 per 6 months (today 24)", method: Customer feedback, basis: assumption}
      - {market: EU, metric: Lumbar adjustment, target: Available on every trim with electric seats, method: Offer check, basis: assumption}

  - id: REQ-F70-EU-IC-02
    domain: interior_comfort
    title: Dual-zone climate as standard and rear ventilation
    statement: >-
      Driver and passenger temperatures shall be adjustable independently on every variant, the
      display shall not suggest zones that are not fitted, and rear passengers shall get air vents.
    recommend: true
    recommend_rationale: >-
      Climatisation (24 rows), climate control panel (24) and climate settings (17, nine wishes)
      describe synced temperatures that cannot be split and a display that looks dual-zone; the
      study scores climate control at 7.31 vs peer 8.13, the largest interior gap.
    horizon: H1
    horizon_rationale: Software activation plus standard-content decision; rear vents in the life-cycle impulse.
    markets: [EU]
    findings:
      - {id: FND-F70-EU-VOC-vehicle_climatization, role: primary}
      - {id: FND-F70-EU-VOC-air_conditioning_control_panel, role: supporting}
      - {id: FND-F70-EU-VOC-air_conditioning_setting, role: supporting}
      - {id: FND-F70-EU-MET-cn_eu_2025-climate_control, role: supporting}
    criteria:
      - {market: EU, metric: Study climate control (1-10), target: ">= 8.0 (today 7.31, peer 8.13)", method: Next EU customer study wave, basis: evidence}
      - {market: EU, metric: Independent driver and passenger temperature, target: Standard on all variants, method: Offer check, basis: assumption}

  - id: REQ-F70-EU-IC-03
    domain: interior_comfort
    title: Cockpit lighting without reflections in the mirrors and windscreen
    statement: >-
      Ambient and display lighting shall not reflect in the side mirrors, side windows or
      windscreen at night at any brightness setting.
    recommend: true
    recommend_rationale: >-
      Instrument panel complaints (33 rows, 11 defects) include repeated reports that dash and
      ambient lights reflect in the door mirrors and windscreen at night, which owners call a
      safety issue.
    horizon: H1
    horizon_rationale: Light guide and default brightness changes.
    markets: [EU]
    findings:
      - {id: FND-F70-EU-VOC-instrument_panel, role: primary}
    criteria:
      - {market: EU, metric: Visible reflection of interior lighting in the side mirrors at night, target: None at default brightness, method: Night visibility test, basis: assumption}

  - id: REQ-F70-EU-DD-01
    domain: driving_dynamics
    title: Comfortable ride on poor road surfaces
    statement: >-
      Non-M variants shall offer a comfort-oriented suspension that absorbs sharp bumps on poor
      European roads without losing the car's sporty handling.
    recommend: true
    recommend_rationale: >-
      Suspension and damping draw 41 complaint rows (2.2 %, 12 wishes for a softer ride) and the
      study scores ride comfort at 9.20 vs peer 9.73; adaptive suspension is standard only on
      the M135.
    horizon: H1
    horizon_rationale: Damper tuning and an adaptive-suspension option fit the life-cycle impulse.
    markets: [EU]
    findings:
      - {id: REDACTED, role: primary}
      - {id: FND-F70-EU-MET-cn_eu_2025-ride_comfort, role: supporting}
      - {id: FND-F70-EU-EQ-cushioning_damping_vehicle, role: context}
    criteria:
      - {market: EU, metric: Study ride comfort (1-10), target: ">= 9.6 (today 9.20, peer 9.73)", method: Next EU customer study wave, basis: evidence}
      - {market: EU, metric: Adaptive suspension, target: Available as option on all variants, method: Offer check, basis: assumption}

  - id: REQ-F70-EU-DD-02
    domain: driving_dynamics
    title: Keep the sporty handling and the fuel economy in the next generation
    statement: The successor shall keep the agile handling and the fuel economy that customers praise today.
    recommend: true
    recommend_rationale: >-
      Sportiness (9.34 vs peer 7.30) and fuel economy (9.30 vs 7.56) are the strongest study
      advantages; driving dynamics collects 415 likes. Strengths to protect.
    horizon: H2
    horizon_rationale: Applies to the successor generation.
    markets: [EU]
    findings:
      - {id: REDACTED, role: primary}
      - {id: FND-F70-EU-MET-STRENGTH-cn_eu_2025-fuel_economy, role: primary}
      - {id: REDACTED, role: supporting}
    criteria:
      - {market: EU, metric: Study sportiness and fuel economy (1-10), target: ">= 9.0 each", method: Customer study of the successor, basis: evidence}

  - id: REQ-F70-EU-PR-01
    domain: powertrain_range_charging
    title: Smooth dual-clutch gearbox and immediate response when pulling away
    statement: >-
      The car shall pull away without a perceptible delay or jerk, including when the throttle is
      pressed while still rolling, and the gearbox shall shift smoothly at low speed and when cold.
    recommend: true
    recommend_rationale: >-
      Drivetrain complaints (123 rows, 6.5 %, 73 usability) and transmission complaints (48 rows,
      12 defects) describe a dead spot when pulling away at junctions and jerky DCT behaviour; the
      study scores acceleration at 8.21 vs 8.90.
    horizon: H1
    horizon_rationale: Engine, hybrid and gearbox calibration.
    markets: [EU]
    findings:
      - {id: FND-F70-EU-VOC-drivetrain, role: primary}
      - {id: FND-F70-EU-VOC-transmission, role: primary}
      - {id: FND-F70-EU-MET-cn_eu_2025-acceleration, role: supporting}
    criteria:
      - {market: EU, metric: Delay from throttle input to traction when rolling below 10 km/h, target: "<= 0.3 s", method: Vehicle measurement, basis: assumption}
      - {market: EU, metric: Study acceleration (1-10), target: ">= 8.8 (today 8.21, peer 8.90)", method: Next EU customer study wave, basis: evidence}
      - {market: EU, metric: Pull-away and gearbox complaint rows, target: "-50 % within 12 months", method: Customer feedback, basis: assumption}

  - id: REQ-F70-EU-SP-01
    domain: space_practicality
    title: Practical boot with power tailgate and luggage fixtures
    statement: >-
      The boot shall offer tie-down points, a 12 V socket and a parcel shelf that stays in place;
      the tailgate shall close from a button on the lid where a power tailgate is fitted.
    recommend: true
    recommend_rationale: >-
      Luggage compartment (23 rows), trunk lid (15 defects) and tailgate operation (19 rows, 12
      wishes) complaints match the study gaps in cargo capacity (7.07 vs 7.47) and loading ease
      (7.50 vs 7.95); the power tailgate is an option on all variants.
    horizon: H1
    horizon_rationale: Boot fixtures and offer changes in the life-cycle impulse.
    markets: [EU]
    findings:
      - {id: FND-F70-EU-VOC-luggage_compartment, role: primary}
      - {id: FND-F70-EU-VOC-trunk_lid_open_close, role: supporting}
      - {id: FND-F70-EU-VOC-trunk_lid, role: supporting}
      - {id: FND-F70-EU-MET-cn_eu_2025-loading_ease, role: supporting}
      - {id: FND-F70-EU-EQ-luggage_compartment, role: context}
    criteria:
      - {market: EU, metric: Study loading ease (1-10), target: ">= 7.9 (today 7.50, peer 7.95)", method: Next EU customer study wave, basis: evidence}
      - {market: EU, metric: Tie-down points and 12 V socket in the boot, target: Every variant, method: Offer check, basis: evidence}

  - id: REQ-F70-EU-DA-01
    domain: driver_assistance
    title: Assistance systems that help instead of irritating
    statement: >-
      Speed-limit warning and lane assistance shall be switchable off with one press per drive,
      and the emergency brake shall not intervene without a real obstacle.
    recommend: true
    recommend_rationale: >-
      Driver assistance draws 24 rows with 17 defects (unexpected braking) and the speed-limit
      assistant 16 rows (14 usability) because it must be switched off after every start.
    horizon: H1
    horizon_rationale: Software within the limits of EU safety regulation.
    markets: [EU]
    findings:
      - {id: REDACTED, role: primary}
      - {id: FND-F70-EU-VOC-speed_limit_assistant, role: supporting}
    criteria:
      - {market: EU, metric: Presses to switch off speed-limit warning and lane assistance, target: "1 (one shortcut for both)", method: Function test, basis: assumption}
      - {market: EU, metric: Unjustified emergency brake interventions reported, target: 0 in the next feedback wave, method: Customer feedback, basis: assumption}
    uncertainties:
      - EU General Safety Regulation requires these systems to be active at every start; only the switch-off effort can change.

  - id: REQ-F70-EU-EX-01
    domain: exterior_design
    title: Reliable exterior lights and helpful door mirrors
    statement: >-
      Exterior lights shall work without fault messages; door mirrors shall tilt down on the
      kerb side when reversing and fold automatically when locking.
    recommend: true
    recommend_rationale: >-
      Exterior lighting draws 26 rows with 19 defects (failed or falsely reported lamps); door
      mirrors 28 rows with 11 wishes for kerb tilt and auto-fold that previous 1 Series had.
    horizon: H1
    horizon_rationale: Production quality and software functions.
    markets: [EU]
    findings:
      - {id: FND-F70-EU-VOC-exterior_lighting, role: primary}
      - {id: FND-F70-EU-VOC-exterior_rearview_mirror, role: primary}
    criteria:
      - {market: EU, metric: Lighting defect rows, target: "<= 5 per 6 months (today 19)", method: Customer feedback, basis: assumption}
      - {market: EU, metric: Kerb-side mirror tilt in reverse, target: Standard on all variants, method: Offer check, basis: assumption}

  - id: REQ-F70-EU-EX-02
    domain: exterior_design
    title: Quiet tyres and wheels that are easy to clean
    statement: >-
      Standard tyres shall keep road noise low on rough surfaces, and wheel designs shall be easy
      to clean and resist corrosion.
    recommend: true
    recommend_rationale: >-
      Wheels and tyres draw 34 complaint rows (15 defects): tyre noise, early corrosion and
      intricate wheel designs that are hard to clean.
    horizon: H1
    horizon_rationale: Tyre sourcing and wheel design in the life-cycle impulse.
    markets: [EU]
    findings:
      - {id: FND-F70-EU-VOC-wheels_tires, role: primary}
      - {id: FND-F70-EU-EQ-wheels_tires, role: context}
    criteria:
      - {market: EU, metric: EU tyre label noise class of standard tyres, target: "A (<= 70 dB)", method: Tyre label, basis: assumption}
      - {market: EU, metric: Wheel corrosion reports in the first year, target: 0, method: Warranty data, basis: assumption}

  - id: REQ-F70-EU-QN-01
    domain: quality_nvh
    title: Quiet, solid-feeling cabin without rattles
    statement: >-
      Doors and interior trim shall be free of rattles and buzzing, and the cabin noise at
      motorway speed shall match the premium compact segment.
    recommend: true
    recommend_rationale: >-
      Front door complaints (16 rows, 13 defects: buzzing, rattles) support the study gaps in
      quietness (7.62 vs peer 8.79, the largest gap of the car) and build quality (7.95 vs 8.23).
    horizon: H1
    horizon_rationale: Acoustic package and assembly fixes.
    markets: [EU]
    findings:
      - {id: FND-F70-EU-MET-cn_eu_2025-quietness, role: primary}
      - {id: FND-F70-EU-VOC-door_front, role: supporting}
      - {id: FND-F70-EU-MET-cn_eu_2025-build_quality, role: supporting}
    criteria:
      - {market: EU, metric: Study quietness (1-10), target: ">= 8.5 (today 7.62, peer 8.79)", method: Next EU customer study wave, basis: evidence}
      - {market: EU, metric: Interior noise at 130 km/h, target: Segment benchmark (value to be set by engineering), method: Acoustic measurement, basis: assumption}

  - id: REQ-F70-EU-GE-01
    domain: general
    title: No silent de-contenting against the previous 1 Series
    statement: >-
      Items that loyal customers used on the previous generation (12 V socket in the boot, rear
      USB charging, mirror kerb tilt, dual-zone climate, fog lights, glove-box light) shall stay
      standard on the comparable trim, or the change shall be shown clearly at configuration.
    recommend: true
    recommend_rationale: >-
      The general equipment theme draws 73 complaint rows with 35 wishes, mostly from repeat
      buyers listing features that were standard on the F40 and are now missing or optional.
    horizon: H1
    horizon_rationale: Standard-content and configurator decision.
    markets: [EU]
    findings:
      - {id: REDACTED, role: primary}
    criteria:
      - {market: EU, metric: Listed items standard on the M Sport trim, target: All, method: Offer check, basis: assumption}
      - {market: EU, metric: Complaint rows about missing standard equipment, target: "-50 % within 12 months", method: Customer feedback, basis: assumption}
    uncertainties:
      - Cost impact not quantified; rough effort follows in Phase 5.

excluded:
  - {finding: FND-F70-EU-MET-cn_eu_2025-value_for_money, reason: "Value perception; F70 already scores above the peer, no product requirement needed."}
  - {finding: REDACTED, reason: "Equal to the peer; no gap to act on."}

            .order_by(Finding.evidence_level, Finding.id)

        with pytest.raises(ValueError):

input.content:
# Step 11 – Requirement derivation (Phase 4, first iteration) and gate G2

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Date | 2026-10-11 |
| Author | Claude (AI assistant), on request of the team |
| Status | Done – 57 requirements for G60 US, G70 US and F70 EU; clean rebuild verified; 40 tests passed |
| Why | Deliverable D2 needs a structured requirement list traceable to findings and sources; until now the chain stopped at the findings |

## 1. Delivered

* **Data model**: `requirement` (ID, vehicle, market, domain, title, statement, 0/1
  recommendation with rationale, horizon H1/H2 with rationale, applicable markets, acceptance
  criteria per market with metric, target, method and basis, assumptions, uncertainties,
  evidence level, priority score for Phase 5, status, version) and `requirement_finding`
  (primary / supporting / context links).
* **Requirement files** `config/requirements/{G60_US,G70_US,F70_EU}.yaml`, written offline by
  the assistant from the findings, study scores and verbatims (D-055). Each file also lists the
  findings the agent filtered out of scope, with a reason (pricing, residual value, warranty,
  off-road on a sedan, low volume).
* **Import** (`requirements/store.py`): validates IDs, domains and finding references (unknown
  or withdrawn findings stop the import), derives the evidence level from the primary and
  supporting findings, versions every change with before / after audit events, withdraws
  requirements removed from the file, logs the exclusions. Re-imports are idempotent.
* **Gate G2**: `tracepoint requirements decide <id> approve|reject|defer --note …` and
  `POST /requirements/{id}/decision`; the rationale is mandatory, the decision is an audit event
  and a line in `config/decisions/requirements.jsonl`, replayed after every import and valid
  only for the version it was made on (D-056).
* **D2 export**: `tracepoint requirements export` writes Markdown and CSV; the committed sample
  is `reports/requirements/requirements_ALL_ALL.{md,csv}`. API `GET /requirements` and
  `GET /requirements/{id}` (requirement → findings → evidence references, plus event history).
* Agent tool `get_requirements` (eighth tool). `start.sh` / `start.ps1` import after the
  finding extraction and export at the end.

## 2. The first requirement set

| Scope | Requirements | Evidence A / B / C | H1 / H2 | Not recommended | Excluded candidates |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| G60 US | 20 | 10 / 9 / 1 | 18 / 2 | 1 (factory CD player) | 6 |
| G70 US | 19 | 8 / 11 / 0 | 16 / 3 | 1 (calmer front design, H2) | 7 |
| F70 EU | 18 | 0 / 18 / 0 | 17 / 1 | 0 | 4 |

F70 EU has no level-A requirement because no F70 EU finding reaches level A (Source A only,
D-037). By domain: infotainment & digital 15, powertrain & charging 9, interior comfort 9,
driving dynamics 7, space 5, exterior 4, general 3, driver assistance 3, quality 2.

Examples: automatic doors that open from a knee touch while driving (G70, safety); touch-only
climate control and the missing rotary controller (F70, 7.4 % of all complaints); seats and
lumbar support (G60, level A, two study gaps); public charging and NACS access (G60 and G70);
start-stop that cannot stay off (all three); functions that expire after three months (F70).
Three requirements protect strengths for the successor generation (handling, sportiness, fuel
economy).

## 3. Known limitations

* Targets: study-score targets are anchored on the 2025 study and the peer mean; complaint
  reductions and engineering values (cool-down time, delays, noise class) are labelled
  `assumption` and need engineering validation.
* Priority score and prioritisation rationale (D2 fields) are empty until Phase 5.
* Requirements are per vehicle × market; the same need in several scopes (climate controls,
  start-stop, onboarding) is not yet consolidated across scopes.
* The catalogue is the German price list; US standard-content statements are flagged as
  uncertain where they rely on it.
* G60 EU (35 findings, few verbatims) and the CN / RoW scopes have no requirement file yet.

## 4. Next step

Phase 5: deterministic scoring with weight profiles in `config/`, stored score components and
a written rationale per requirement, re-scoring and report diff on a weight change (gate G3).

Gereksinim türetme entegre edildi: G60 US, G70 US ve F70 EU için toplam 57 gereksinim sisteme girdi ve her biri bulgulardan kaynak verbatim'e kadar izlenebiliyor. `./start.sh --reset` ile sıfırdan kurulumu denedim; 40 testin hepsi geçti. Henüz hiçbir şey commit edilmedi.

**Okumak için:** `reports/requirements/requirements_ALL_ALL.md`. Aynı liste CSV olarak da var.

**İçerik**

| Kapsam | Gereksinim | Kanıt A / B / C | H1 / H2 | Önerilmeyen |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| G60 US | 20 | 7 / 12 / 1 | 18 / 2 | 1 (fabrika CD çalar) |
| G70 US | 19 | 11 / 8 / 0 | 16 / 3 | 1 (daha sade ön tasarım) |
| F70 EU | 18 | 0 / 18 / 0 | 17 / 1 | 0 |

- Öne çıkan örnekler:
  - G70: sürüş sırasında dizle kapı açma düğmesine dokununca açılan otomatik kapılar (güvenlik sorunu).
  - F70: sadece dokunmatik ekrandan yönetilen klima ve kaldırılan döner kumanda (tüm şikâyetlerin %7,4'ü).
  - G60: koltuk konforu (A seviyesi kanıt, iki study açığı).
  - Üç kapsamda da: kalıcı olarak kapatılamayan start-stop.
  - G60 ve G70: halka açık şarj ağı ve Tesla Supercharger erişimi.
- Üç gereksinim, mevcut güçlü yanları gelecek nesilde korumak için yazıldı (yol tutuşu, sportiflik, yakıt tüketimi).
- Önerilmeyen iki gereksinimi bilerek listede bıraktım; PM'in vereceği kararı göstermek için. Örneğin G70 ön tasarımı: ızgaraya 10 şikâyet ve 18 tasarım isteği var, ama dış tasarım 210 övgüyle aracın en güçlü yanı.
- 17 bulgu kapsam dışı bırakıldı, her birinin gerekçesi yazılı ve loglu (fiyat, ikinci el değeri, garanti, düşük hacim gibi).
- F70 EU'da A seviyesi gereksinim yok. Sebebi, oradaki bulguların tek kaynaktan (Source A) gelmesi; bu D-037 kuralının sonucu, bir hata değil.

**Mekanizma**
- **Gereksinim dosyaları:** `config/requirements/<araç>_<pazar>.yaml`, commit edilecek. Import sırasında şunlar kontrol ediliyor: ID formatı, domain, bulgu ID'lerinin gerçekten var olup olmadığı ve geri çekilmiş bir bulguya bağlanıp bağlanmadığı. Kanıt seviyesi bağlı bulgulardan otomatik hesaplanıyor. Her değişiklik yeni bir versiyon ve önce/sonra halini içeren bir audit event oluşturuyor.
- **G2 kararı:** `tracepoint requirements decide REQ-... approve --note "..."` veya `POST /requirements/{id}/decision`. Gerekçe zorunlu.
  - Kararlar `config/decisions/requirements.jsonl` dosyasına yazılıyor ve her yeniden kurulumda tekrar uygulanıyor.
  - Bir karar, verildiği versiyon için geçerli. Gereksinim değişirse durumu tekrar "proposed" olur ve yeni karar ister.
- **API:** `GET /requirements` liste döndürüyor. `GET /requirements/{id}` gereksinim → bulgu → kanıt zincirini ve olay geçmişini gösteriyor.
- **Agent:** `get_requirements` adında sekizinci bir araç ekledim.
- **Kararlar:** D-055 ve D-056 olarak kayıtlı; rapor `reports/step-11-requirement-derivation.md`.

**Bilmen gerekenler**
- **Hedef değerler:** Study skorlarına dayanan hedefler `evidence` olarak işaretli. Mühendislik değerleri (soğutma süresi, gecikme, gürültü sınıfı) ve şikâyet düşüş hedefleri benim önerim; `assumption` olarak işaretli ve mühendislik doğrulaması gerekiyor.
- **Öncelik skoru:** D2'nin istediği öncelik skoru ve gerekçesi henüz boş; bunlar Faz 5'te dolacak.
- **Kapsamlar arası birleştirme:** Aynı ihtiyaç farklı kapsamlarda ayrı gereksinim olarak duruyor (örneğin start-stop üç kapsamda tekrar ediyor). Bunları birleştirme işi henüz yapılmadı.
- **İlk yazımda hata:** Step 11 raporundaki kanıt seviyesi sayılarını ilk yazışta yanlış yazmıştım. DB ile kontrol edip düzelttim; yukarıdaki tablo doğrulanmış hali.

Sıradaki mantıklı adım Faz 5, yani önceliklendirme. D2'yi tamamlayan ve G3 gate'inin temeli olan adım bu. Commit edilmemiş üç adım birikti (step 09, 10 ve 11). Önce bunları branch açıp commit'leyeyim ve PR oluşturayım mı, yoksa doğrudan Faz 5'e mi geçeyim?

def test_api_endpoints(engine, ingested):
    api_module._engine = engine
    client = TestClient(api_module.app)
    assert client.get("/health").json()["status"] == "ok"
    vehicles = client.get("/vehicles").json()
    assert {v["code"] for v in vehicles} >= {"F70", "G60", "G70"}
    res = client.get(
        "/verbatims",
        params={"vehicle": "G60", "powertrain": "BEV", "feedback_type": "Wants", "limit": 5},
    ).json()
    assert res["total"] > 0 and len(res["items"]) == 5
    item = res["items"][0]
    assert item["locator"]["row"] >= 2 and item["evidence_ref"].startswith("verbatim:")
    one = client.get(f"/verbatims/{item['id']}").json()
    assert one["id"] == item["id"]
    eq = client.get("/equipment", params={"vehicle": "F70", "q": "Lenkradheizung"}).json()
    assert any(e["sa_code"] == "248" for e in eq)
    ev = client.get("/events", params={"action": "verbatims.ingested"}).json()
    assert ev["total"] >= 3
    rep = client.get("/reports/baseline/G60", params={"market": "US"}).json()
    assert rep["coverage"]["verbatims"] > 3000 and rep["domains"]

API: server-side actor for G2 decisions, JSON-only write bodies

The decision endpoint took the actor and the decision from query parameters, so
any client could record a decision under any name and a cross-site form post
could trigger one. The actor now comes from TRACEPOINT_HUMAN_ACTOR_ID, the
decision and its rationale are a JSON body (a text/plain or form post is
rejected), and tool calls over HTTP can only be attributed to agent:* actors.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF

Güvenlik incelemesinin bulduğu sorunu düzelttim ve commit'ledim; henüz push etmedim. İnceleme iki kez bildirim gönderdi, ikisi de aynı sorunla ilgiliydi.

**Sorun neydi**
- G2 karar endpoint'i (`POST /requirements/{id}/decision`) kimin karar verdiğini istemcinin gönderdiği `actor` alanından alıyordu. Yani herkes istediği isimle karar yazabiliyordu ve bu isim hem audit log'a hem commit edilen karar dosyasına giriyordu.
- Parametreler URL'den geldiği için, API açıkken tarayıcıda açılan kötü niyetli bir sayfa bu endpoint'e basit bir istek atarak karar yazdırabilirdi (CSRF).
- Agent araç çağrısı endpoint'inde de kim adına çağrı yapıldığı istemciden geliyordu.

**Nasıl düzelttim**
- Kararı veren kişi artık sunucu tarafında `TRACEPOINT_HUMAN_ACTOR_ID` ayarından alınıyor. İstemci bunu değiştiremiyor.
- Karar ve gerekçesi artık sadece JSON gövdesi olarak kabul ediliyor. Form veya düz metin gönderimi 422 ile reddediliyor; tarayıcının başka bir siteden yapabileceği basit istekler bu yüzden işe yaramıyor.
- Gerekçe en az 3 karakter olmak zorunda.
- HTTP üzerinden yapılan araç çağrıları sadece `agent:*` adıyla kaydedilebiliyor, `human:pm` gibi bir kimlik verilemiyor.
- Bunları kontrol eden bir test ekledim; 41 testin hepsi geçiyor.
- API zaten varsayılan olarak sadece kendi makinende (127.0.0.1) dinliyor, dışarıdan erişilemiyor.

Kimlik doğrulama hâlâ yok; prototipte tek PM kullanıcısı olduğu için bu bilinçli bir tercih (D-014).

Düzeltme branch'te bir commit önde duruyor. Bunu da push edeyim mi?
